candidate_requirements.requirement: Review specimen-specific microbiology, susceptibilities and sampling dates, including obtaining fresh cultures rather than relying on prior susceptibilities.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Multiple organisms across procedures and absent fresh cultures at a later procedure materially change infectious-versus-inflammatory inference and antibiotic choice.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Original culture, susceptibility and pathology reports linked to each procedure; repeat intraoperative cultures.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before any change to antibiotic or immunosuppressive therapy; proposed in this written analysis.

candidate_requirements.rationale: Inflammatory and infectious processes may coexist, and infliximab was held, so disease activity and immune status are decision-critical.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Focused multidisciplinary reassessment; repeat enterography or endoscopic assessment.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before any change to immunosuppressive treatment; proposed in this written analysis.
